culprit_citations.quoted_text: Artisan Bidco, Inc. (3) | First-lien loan ($ 38,438 par, due 11/2029) | Amortized Cost $37,903 | Fair Value $38,245

findings.detail: The 376-row comparative investment schedule was included in the 735-row completeness denominator, leaving the 359 current-period rows as the applicable schedule population.

rationale: B01 reports 359 of 735 leaves with fair value and exactly 376 residual rows. Raw source contains a second parallel investment schedule at tables 18-24; table 18 row 4 is a fully valued Artisan Bidco position with fair value $38,245, while the current-period schedule is separately presented at tables 8-14. Thus the 376-row residual is the comparative schedule leaking into the denominator, not missing fair values on current-period positions. The applicable schedule population is 359 rather than 735.
